newsitem.title: GERMANY: United Carriers launches UK-N.Am parcels service.
newsitem.headline: United Carriers launches UK-N.Am parcels service.

text.p: United Carriers Group has set up its first direct UK-North America air cargo service, European parcels group General Parcel Logistics (GP) said.
The British parcels firm, a GP franchise partner, had cut transatlantic parcel delivery times by up to 48 hours through the new direct service, a statement said.
Parcels are now flown daily with American Airlines from Birmingham to Chicago for onward transportation by Roadway Package System to destinations in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, a statement said.
John Toyne, United Carriers chairman, said: "Before the introduction of the new service, our North America parcels went via Frankfurt airport.
"With the new service, we have not only reduced our organisational processes but above all, we have reduced regular delivery times by 24 to 48 hours," he added.
The company now guarantees delivery times of four days from the UK to the North American region.

United Carriers, one of Britain's largest parcels firms with 2,500 employees, 22 depots and 192 scheduled services, handled more than 27 million parcels in 1996, the statement said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
